blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate mapping of shallow-water environments using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenged by water-induced distortions, including refraction, caustics, and wavelength-dependent attenuation. The scarcity of paired distorted and reference imagery further limits the development of supervised restoration methods. To address this challenge, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 high-resolution UAV images with 12,800 degraded observations generated through Blender-based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. We further propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework integrating a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), cross-attention, and a composite reconstruction objective to restore shallow-water imagery. We evaluated the framework against eight image-restoration methods, complemented by architectural ablations and cross-dataset experiments. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 31.715 +/- 0.439 dB, structural similarity index (SSIM) of 0.849 +/- 0.002, and learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) of 0.145 +/- 0.007 across three training seeds. On the independent Sea-Undistort dataset, sampler-aware fine-tuning improved restoration fidelity, reaching 19.469 +/- 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 +/- 0.005 SSIM under combined water-surface distortions, although perceptual trade-offs remained. Additional experiments on real UAV imagery examined feature preservation and segmentation behavior. These findings demonstrate the potential of semi-synthetic training and conditional diffusion for shallow-water image restoration while highlighting the importance of evaluating both reconstruction fidelity and downstream remote-sensing utility.
blocks.zh: 使用无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)图像准确绘制浅水环境图受到由水引起的扭曲,包括折射、腐蚀和波长依赖衰减的挑战。 配对扭曲和参考图像的缺乏进一步限制了监督恢复方法的发展。 为了应对这一挑战,我们介绍了KAUSTics,这是一个半合成数据集,将32个高分辨率无人驾驶飞行器图像产生的1,280个参考补丁与12,800个退化观测数据结合起来,这些观测数据是通过以Blender为基础的水面渲染以及经验色和模糊的增强产生的。 我们进一步提出KAUSTics-Net,这是一个像素-空间有条件的传播框架,其中包含一个多尺度的有条件编码器,特异性线性调制(FiLM),交叉意向,以及恢复浅水影像的综合重建目标. 我们用8个图像恢复方法评估了框架,并辅之以建筑活化和跨数据集实验。 在KAUSTics上,KAUSTics-Net实现了平均峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR)31.715 +/- 0.439 dB,结构相似指数(SSIM)为0.849 +/- 0.002,并在三个训练种子上实现了0.145 +/- 0.007的知觉图像补丁相似度(LPIPS). 在独立的"海-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地-地-地-地-----地--------------------------------------- 关于真实的无人驾驶飞行器图像的其他实验检查了特征保存和分解行为。 这些调查结果表明半合成培训和有条件地传播浅水图像修复的潜力,同时强调评价重建忠心度和下游遥感效用的重要性。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Coastal regions support critical ecosystems, including coral reefs, seagrass meadows, mangroves, and tidal flats, while also hosting substantial populations and infrastructure. Their monitoring is essential for ecosystem assessment, coastal management, restoration, and climate adaptation [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Although in situ surveys provide detailed observations, they are spatially limited, logistically demanding, and often unable to capture rapid changes in dynamic coastal environments [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Satellite and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) remote sensing provide broader and more frequent coverage, enabling shallow-water mapping at scales impractical for field surveys alone [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 沿海地区支持重要的生态系统,包括珊瑚礁、海草草地、红树林和潮汐平原,同时也接纳了大量人口和基础设施。 它们的监测对于生态系统评估、沿海管理、恢复和气候适应[1、2、3、4]至关重要。 虽然实地调查提供了详细的观测结果,但空间有限、后勤要求高,往往无法捕捉动态沿海环境的迅速变化[5、6、7]。 卫星和无人驾驶航空飞行器(无人驾驶飞行器)遥感提供更广泛和更频繁的覆盖范围,使得浅水测绘在规模上不切实际,仅对实地调查[8、9、10]。

blocks.en: Extracting reliable information from optical imagery over shallow coastal waters nevertheless remains challenging. Surface waves focus and defocus sunlight, producing dynamic, high-frequency caustic patterns unrelated to actual seabed variability [ 11 , 12 ] . Specular reflection at the air–water interface generates sun glint that can saturate parts of the image and obscure the underlying scene [ 13 , 14 ] . Refraction displaces apparent object locations and distorts submerged shapes, while wavelength-dependent absorption and scattering alter the signal returning from the seafloor. Together, these effects degrade contrast and color, distort geometry, and complicate applications such as benthic habitat mapping [ 15 ] , bathymetry [ 16 ] , and photogrammetry [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,从浅海沿岸水域的光学图像中提取可靠信息仍然是一项挑战。 表面波聚焦和去聚焦日光,产生与实际海底变异无关的动态高频凸变规律[11,12]. 光谱反射在空气-水界面产生阳光闪烁,可以饱和部分图像,并遮蔽基本场景[13,14]. 折射取代了表面物体的位置,扭曲了潜伏的形状,而波长依赖吸收和散射则改变从海底返回的信号。 这些效应共同降解了对比和颜色,扭曲了几何特征,并使海底生境测绘[15],水深测量[16],摄影测量[17]等应用复杂化.

blocks.en: Several approaches have been proposed to mitigate water-induced distortions. Physics-based methods invert simplified radiative-transfer models but often require estimates of water depth, optical properties, and atmospheric conditions [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] . Image-processing approaches apply deglinting, dehazing, contrast enhancement, or multi-view corrections [ 21 , 16 , 12 ] . More recently, deep learning has enabled data-driven mappings between distorted and reference imagery. GAN-based methods have been applied to underwater enhancement and coastal water removal [ 22 , 13 , 23 ] , while diffusion-based image-to-image models have demonstrated capabilities for removing complex degradations while preserving scene structure [ 24 , 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 提出了若干办法,以减轻水引起的扭曲。 基于物理的方法反转简化了辐射转移模型,但往往需要估计水深、光学性质和大气条件[18、19、20]。 图像处理方法采用脱光、脱色、对比增强或多视图校正[21、16、12]。 最近,深入的学习使数据驱动的地图绘制工作在扭曲的图像和参考图像之间得以进行。 以GAN为基础的方法已经应用于水下增强和沿海水的清除[22,13,23],而以扩散为基础的图像到图像模型已经显示出在保留场景结构的同时消除复杂退化的能力[24,25].

blocks.en: However, learning-based restoration of shallow-water UAV imagery is constrained by the scarcity of large, high-resolution paired datasets containing observations of the same scene with and without water-surface distortions [ 23 , 26 ] . Repeated acquisitions under different sea states and illumination rarely provide aligned pairs and make it difficult to separate water-surface effects from genuine scene changes [ 10 ] . Purely synthetic data, in contrast, may not capture the spatial complexity and variability of real coastal environments. This motivates semi-synthetic approaches that combine real UAV imagery with physically based simulations of water-induced distortions.
blocks.zh: 然而,基于学习的浅水无人驾驶飞行器图像恢复工作受到以下因素的限制:缺乏大型高分辨率配对数据集,其中包含对同一场景的观测数据,无论有无水面扭曲[23、26]。 在不同海态和照明下反复获得很少提供对齐的配对,也难以将水面效应与真实场景变化区分开来[10]. 相反,纯粹的合成数据可能无法捕捉真实沿海环境的空间复杂性和可变性。 这激发了将真实的无人驾驶飞行器图像与物理模拟水引起的扭曲相结合的半合成方法。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset for high-resolution UAV water-distortion removal, together with KAUSTics-Net, a conditional diffusion-based restoration framework. We evaluated the proposed approach on KAUSTics and the independent Sea-Undistort benchmark [ 26 ] , complemented by an exploratory assessment on real UAV imagery.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了KAUSTics,一个用于高分辨率UAV水分漂移清除的半合成数据集,以及KAUSTics-Net,一个有条件的基于扩散的恢复框架. 我们评价了关于KAUSTics和独立的海-地下基准的拟议方法[26],并辅之以对真实的无人驾驶航空器图像的探索性评估。

blocks.en: In summary, this work makes the following contributions: • We introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset comprising 1,280 high-resolution UAV reference patches and 12,800 degraded observations generated through physically based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations. • We propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework combining multi-scale conditioning, FiLM-modulated residual blocks, cross-attention, and a composite restoration objective for through-water UAV imagery. • We evaluate KAUSTics-Net against eight restoration methods using source-image-disjoint partitions, architectural ablations, cross-dataset experiments, and real-UAV assessments of downstream image-processing utility.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这项工作作出了以下贡献: 我们介绍KAUSTics,这是一个半合成数据集,由1,280个高分辨率无人驾驶飞行器参考补丁和12,800个退化观测数据组成,这些观测数据是通过物理水面渲染、经验色和模糊的增强产生的。 我们提出KAUSTics-Net,这是一个像素-空间有条件的传播框架,结合了多尺度的调制,FiLM调制的残余区块,跨意向,以及透水无人驾驶飞行器图像的综合恢复目标。 我们用8种恢复方法来评估KAUSTics-Net,这些方法使用源-图像-离合分区、建筑模拟、跨数据集实验和下游图像处理实用性的实际UAV评估。

blocks.en: We introduce KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset comprising 1,280 high-resolution UAV reference patches and 12,800 degraded observations generated through physically based water-surface rendering and empirical color and blur augmentations.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍KAUSTics,这是一个半合成数据集,由1,280个高分辨率无人驾驶飞行器参考补丁和12,800个通过基于物理的水面渲染、经验色和模糊的增强产生的退化观测数据组成。

blocks.en: We propose KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework combining multi-scale conditioning, FiLM-modulated residual blocks, cross-attention, and a composite restoration objective for through-water UAV imagery.
blocks.zh: 我们提出KAUSTics-Net,这是一个像素-空间有条件的传播框架,结合了多尺度的调制,FiLM调制的残余块,交叉注意,以及透水无人机图像的综合恢复目标.

blocks.en: We evaluate KAUSTics-Net against eight restoration methods using source-image-disjoint partitions, architectural ablations, cross-dataset experiments, and real-UAV assessments of downstream image-processing utility.
blocks.zh: 我们用8种恢复方法来评估KAUSTics-Net,这些方法使用源-图像-离合分区、建筑模拟、跨数据集实验和下游图像处理实用性的实际UAV评估。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Image restoration has been extensively studied across computer vision and remote sensing, including dehazing, deblurring, deraining, and underwater image enhancement. However, methods explicitly targeting water-surface distortions such as caustics, sun glint, and refraction in high-resolution UAV imagery remain comparatively limited. In practice, many approaches applied to this problem were originally developed for generic image restoration or underwater cameras rather than through-water aerial observations [ 27 , 23 , 28 ] . Existing approaches can be broadly grouped into statistical and physics-based corrections, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and diffusion-based restoration models.
blocks.zh: 在计算机视觉和遥感方面对图像修复进行了广泛的研究,包括脱污、脱污、脱水和水下图像增强。 然而,在高分辨率无人驾驶飞行器图像中,明确针对水面扭曲,如致癌物、太阳克林特和折射的方法仍然相对有限。 在实践中,许多处理这一问题的方法最初是为一般图像恢复或水下照相机,而不是通过水上航空观测[27、23、28]。 现有方法可大致分为统计学和物理学的校正、基因对抗网络(GANs)和扩散修复模型。

blocks.en: II-A Statistical and Physics-Based Approaches
blocks.zh: II-A 统计和物理方法

blocks.en: In UAV-based shallow-water imaging, refraction at the air–water interface displaces apparent object locations and distorts submerged shapes, while wave-induced caustics and sun glint introduce strong spatially varying radiometric artifacts [ 29 , 12 ] . Early correction methods primarily focused on geometric effects by applying empirical refraction factors derived from Snell’s law. Partama et al. proposed a correction of apparent depths from UAV structure-from-motion reconstructions, while related studies incorporated refraction correction into shallow-water bathymetric inversion schemes [ 30 , 31 ] . Reviews of UAV-based shallow-water bathymetry have highlighted the effectiveness of these approaches, but also their dependence on acquisition geometry, water depth, seabed properties, and assumptions regarding the water surface [ 32 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 在以无人驾驶飞行器为基础的浅水成像中,空气-水界面的折射取代了表面物体的位置,扭曲了下沉的形状,而波引起的凸缘和太阳闪光则引入了空间差异很大的辐射测量文物[29、12]。 早期的校正方法主要通过运用从斯内尔定律中得出的实证折射因子,专注于几何效应. Partama等人建议纠正无人驾驶航空器结构的明显深度 -- -- 从运动开始的重建,而相关研究则将折射修正纳入浅水水水深反演方案[30,31]。 对基于无人驾驶航空器的浅水水深测量法的审查突出了这些方法的有效性,但也强调了这些方法对获取几何、水深、海底特性以及对水面的假设的依赖性[32、33]。

blocks.en: A complementary family of methods exploits temporal redundancy in high-frame-rate imagery. Fluid lensing uses repeated observations of the same scene to model the dynamic water surface as a time-varying optical lens and reconstruct refraction-corrected, caustic-reduced imagery [ 34 , 35 ] . More recently, Scilla et al. showed that frame-wise temporal aggregation combined with color-transfer correction can reduce caustics, refraction-induced shape variations, and sun glint in UAV video while improving the consistency of submerged features [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 在高帧率图像中,各种方法的互补性利用了时间冗余。 流体透镜利用对同一场景的反复观测,将动态水面建模为时间变化的光学透镜,并重建折射校正的,custic的缩小图像[34,35]. 最近,Scilla et al. 显示帧式时间集聚与色调校正相结合,可以降低空外线视频中的caustic,折射引发的形状变异,以及太阳闪烁,同时提高潜水特征的一致性[12].

blocks.en: Although effective, these approaches generally rely on explicit physical assumptions, hand-crafted corrections, or repeated observations of the same scene. They therefore do not directly learn a single-image mapping from a distorted observation to a clean seabed representation, motivating the use of data-driven generative models.
blocks.zh: 这些方法虽然有效,但一般依靠明确的物理假设、手工修正或对同一场景的反复观察。 因此,它们并不直接从扭曲的观察到清洁的海底代表性学习单图,从而推动使用数据驱动的基因模型。

blocks.en: II-B Generative Adversarial Networks
blocks.zh: II-B 基因辅助网络

blocks.en: Generative adversarial networks learn image distributions through competition between a generator and discriminator [ 36 ] , and have been widely adopted for image enhancement and restoration. In image-to-image translation, CycleGAN introduced cycle consistency for learning mappings between unpaired image domains [ 37 ] , a particularly useful property when paired distorted and clean observations are difficult to acquire.
blocks.zh: 基因对抗网络通过生成者与歧视者之间的竞争学习图像分布[36],并被广泛采用用于图像增强和修复. 在图像到图像的翻译中,CycleGAN引入了在未发光的图像域之间学习映射的周期一致性[37],当配对扭曲和清洁的观测很难获得时,这是一个特别有用的属性.

blocks.en: Underwater enhancement models such as UGAN, FUnIE-GAN, MLFcGAN, and UWGAN use adversarial learning to improve color balance, contrast, local structure, and, in some cases, downstream robotic perception [ 27 , 38 , 39 , 40 ] . These approaches have demonstrated substantial improvements for imagery acquired by underwater cameras. However, their target domain differs from through-water UAV imagery, where wave-induced refraction, dynamic caustics, and sun glint introduce stronger spatially varying geometric and radiometric distortions.
blocks.zh: UGAN,FUNIE-GAN,MLFcGAN,UWGAN等水下增强型模型利用对抗性学习,改善颜色平衡,对比,局部结构,在某些情况下,下游机器人感知[27,38,39,40]. 这些方法表明,水下摄像头获取的图像有很大改进。 然而,其目标域与透水UAV影像不同,其中波引起的折射,动态致癌,阳光闪烁引入了空间差异较大的几何和辐射扭曲.

blocks.en: Only a limited number of GAN-based methods have directly addressed aerial water removal. DeWaterGAN is a physics-guided unsupervised framework for UAV coastal imagery that combines a CycleGAN backbone with a light-transport-inspired attention mechanism [ 23 ] . The model can reduce water interference while preserving color and texture, but it primarily targets appearance restoration and does not rely on pixel-aligned distorted/undistorted training pairs.
blocks.zh: 只有少数基于GAN的方法直接处理空中取水问题。 DeWaterGAN是无人驾驶飞行器海岸影像的物理导引无监督的框架,它结合了循环GAN主干线和光传动的注意机制[23]. 该模型在保留色彩和纹理的同时可以减少水干扰,但主要针对外观恢复,不依赖于像素相配扭曲/未分解的训练配对.

blocks.en: Overall, GAN-based methods demonstrate the potential of learned restoration, but their application to through-water UAV imagery remains challenging, as these images belong to substantially different domains, containing stronger refraction induced distortions, and complex caustic patterns that are not fully captured in classical underwater datasets.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,基于GAN的方法显示出学习到的恢复潜力,但其应用于透水无人驾驶飞行器图像仍然具有挑战性,因为这些图像属于大不相同的领域,包含较强的折射诱导扭曲,以及复杂的诱因模式,而这些模式在古典水下数据集中没有被完全捕获。

blocks.en: II-C Diffusion and Advanced Restoration Models
blocks.zh: II-C 传播和高级恢复模型

blocks.en: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models progressively corrupt training data with Gaussian noise and learn the reverse denoising process [ 41 ] . Latent diffusion models, including Stable Diffusion, further reduce computational cost by performing this process in a compressed representation space [ 42 ] . Conditional diffusion models extend this framework to image-to-image restoration by incorporating degraded observations into the denoising process. For instance, Palette introduced a general conditional diffusion framework for image-to-image translation [ 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 贬低扩散概率模型用高斯噪音逐渐腐蚀了训练数据,并学习了反向解析过程[41]. 包括稳定扩散在内的Lententnt扩散模型,通过在压缩的表示空间进行这一过程,进一步降低计算成本[42]. 有条件的传播模型将这一框架扩大到图像到图像的恢复,将退化的观测纳入去名过程。 例如,Palette引入了图像到图像翻译的一般有条件传播框架[43].

blocks.en: Several diffusion-based approaches have been developed for underwater image enhancement. UW-DDPM introduced a dual-U-Net formulation with distribution-fusion sampling [ 44 ] , while DiffWater incorporated degraded-image and color-compensated guidance to improve underwater image restoration [ 28 ] . Related studies have investigated accelerated sampling strategies and alternative conditioning mechanisms [ 45 , 46 ] . Beyond underwater imagery, NDR-Restore learns degradation representations to address multiple corruption types [ 47 ] , while ResShift formulates diffusion in the residual space between degraded and reference images to reduce the number of sampling steps [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh: 已经为增强水下图像开发了一些基于传播的方法。 UW-DDPM采用了配有分布-聚变采样的双U-Net配方[44],而DiffWater则纳入了退化成像和色补偿的指南,以改善水下图像修复[28]. 相关研究调查了加速取样战略和替代条件机制[45、46]。 除了水下图像外,NDR-Restore还学习降解表示,以解决多种腐败类型[47],而ResShift则在退化图像和参考图像之间的剩余空间中形成扩散,以减少采样步骤的数量[48].

blocks.en: Alternative deep learning architectures have also been developed for underwater image enhancement. SS-UIE combines spatial selective scanning and spectral attention to address nonuniform image degradation [ 49 ] , while U-Shape Transformer integrates multi-scale channel-wise feature fusion and spatial global modeling [ 50 ] . These methods provide complementary restoration strategies beyond conventional convolutional and diffusion-based frameworks.
blocks.zh: 还为水下图像增强开发了替代的深层学习架构. SS-UIE将空间选择性扫描和光谱关注结合起来,以解决非统一图像退化问题[49],而U-Shape变形器则整合了多尺度的信道特性聚变和空间全球模型[50]. 这些方法提供了超出传统演变和传播框架的补充性恢复战略。

blocks.en: More recently, the Sea-Undistort dataset introduced a paired synthetic benchmark for through-water airborne imagery and evaluated restoration models under sun glint, scattering, and wave-induced distortions [ 26 ] . These results demonstrate the potential of learning-based restoration for aerial through-water observations. However, most existing restoration methods were developed for underwater-camera imagery or general image degradation rather than through-water UAV observations. Moreover, the availability of large paired datasets preserving the texture and spatial complexity of real coastal UAV imagery remains limited.
blocks.zh: 最近,海-地下数据集引入了透水空气成像的对联合成基准,并评价了太阳闪烁、散射和波引起的扭曲下的恢复模型[26]。 这些结果表明,在通过水进行空中观测时,有以学习为基础的恢复潜力。 然而,现有的大多数恢复方法都是为水下摄像头图像或一般图像退化而不是通过水中无人驾驶航空器观测而开发的。 此外,保存真实的沿海无人驾驶飞行器图像的纹理和空间复杂性的大型配对数据集的可用性仍然有限。

blocks.en: The present work addresses this gap by introducing KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset combining real high-resolution UAV imagery with rendered water-surface distortions and empirical appearance augmentations, together with KAUSTics-Net, a conditional diffusion framework tailored to this setting. This combination enables supervised restoration toward calm-water reference imagery and controlled evaluation under multiple caustic patterns, blur levels, and color transformations.
blocks.zh: 本工作通过采用KAUSTics这一半合成数据集来解决这一差距,该数据集将真实的高分辨率无人机图像与水面扭曲和实证外观增强相结合,并与KAUSTics-Net(一个适合这一环境的有条件传播框架)相结合。 这种组合有助于有监督地恢复到平静-水的参考图像,并在多种原因模式、模糊水平和色变下进行有控制的评价。

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: III-A KAUSTics Dataset
blocks.zh: III-A KAUSTics 数据集

blocks.en: The KAUSTics dataset builds on UAV surveys conducted in June 2024 between 8 and 9 AM at the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), approximately 80 km north of Jeddah on the Red Sea coast of Saudi Arabia (22.34 ∘ N, 39.09 ∘ E). The surveys were originally collected for coastal monitoring applications, including habitat mapping. For this study, we selected 32 images acquired over a shallow-water lagoon (depth < 3 <3 m; Fig. 1 ) under clear-sky and low-wind conditions to minimize visible water-surface distortions.
blocks.zh: KAUSTics数据集基于2024年6月8日至9日在沙特阿拉伯红海沿岸吉达以北约80公里处阿卜杜拉国王科技大学(KAUST)进行的无人驾驶航空器调查(北纬22.34°,东经39.09°)。 这些调查最初是收集用于海岸监测应用,包括生境测绘。 为进行这项研究,我们选定了32幅在清空和低风条件下在一个浅水泻湖(深度 < 3 < 3米;图1)上获得的图像,以尽量减少明显的水面扭曲。

blocks.en: The images were acquired using a DJI Matrice 300 RTK flying at 35 m altitude and equipped with a Zenmuse P1 45-MP full-frame camera with a 35 mm lens. Each frame had a resolution of 8192 × 5460 8192\times 5460 pixels and a ground sampling distance of approximately 0.4 ​ c ​ m / p ​ i ​ x ​ e ​ l 0.4~cm/pixel . The surveyed area included sandy, rocky, seagrass, and macroalgal substrates. The selected images represent different seabed textures and visual characteristics observed in the lagoon and serve as calm-water reference targets. Their geometric and radiometric accuracy has not been independently established.

The orange lines indicate the approximate area of interest of the UAV surveys used to acquire the calm-water reference imagery over shallow reef flats and sandy substrates.

blocks.en: Synthetic surface distortions were generated using Blender [ 51 ] by mapping the UAV-derived reference imagery onto the bottom plane of a virtual shallow-water scene and rendering it through a simulated water surface. The rendering process introduced wave-induced illumination focusing (caustics) and refractive displacement. Sun glint was not independently parameterized or controlled in the KAUSTics rendering process. The virtual camera was configured to provide a reproducible nadir-viewing geometry at an altitude of 10 m, with a sensor size of 13.2 × 8.8 13.2\times 8.8 mm, a focal length of 6.201 mm, and a rendering resolution of 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixels. The rendering setup is illustrated in Fig. 2 .

(a) Blender scene showing the UAV-derived seafloor texture mapped onto the bottom plane and viewed by a nadir-looking camera. (b) Mesh of the simulated water surface generated using the Ocean Modifier, with a central zoom showing its spatial sampling density.

blocks.en: Water-surface geometry was simulated using Blender’s Ocean Modifier with the Shallow Water spectrum, a depth parameter of 0.4 m, Spatial Size of 49 m, wave-amplitude Scale of 0.025, and wind velocity of 5 m s -1 . The geometry Size parameter was set to 0.190, with a water-object scale of approximately 1.665. Two distinct caustic patterns were generated by varying the surface alignment parameters: Shape 1 used an alignment of 0, producing predominantly cell-like caustics, whereas Shape 2 used an alignment of 0.1, a direction of 90°, and damping of 0.5, producing more parallel structures (Fig. 3 ). Surface realizations were varied through the Ocean Modifier’s random seed. All scenes were rendered using Blender Cycles with OptiX acceleration on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (80 GB). These parameters define the synthetic scene configuration and do not represent measured hydrodynamic or optical properties of the lagoon.
blocks.zh: 利用Blender的海洋变换器模拟了水面几何,其深度参数为0.4米,空间大小为49米,波幅为0.025,风速为5米秒-1。 几何大小参数被设定为0.190,水对象尺度约为1.665. 不同的表面对齐参数产生了两种不同的因果关系: 元件1使用0对齐,主要产生细胞状的致癌物,而元件2则使用0.1对齐,方向90°,加坝0.5,产生更多的平行结构(图3). 通过海洋变换器的随机种子,表面的实现是不同的。 所有场景均使用带有OptiX加速度的Blender Cycles在NVIDIA A100 GPU(80 GB)上渲染. 这些参数定义了合成场景配置,并不代表泻湖的测量流体动力学或光学特性.

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Overview of the KAUSTics semi-synthetic dataset. UAV imagery is divided into 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixel reference patches and rendered in Blender to generate two caustic patterns. Gaussian blur and three empirical color-transfer configurations (Color 1–3) expand the dataset to ten degraded observations per reference patch.
blocks.zh: 图3:KAUSTics半合成数据集概况. UAV图像分为1000×1000×1000\time1000像素参考补丁,并以Blender渲染生成两个caustic图案. 高斯模糊,三个经验性的色彩转移配置(Color 1–3)将数据集扩展为每个参考补丁的十个退化观测.

blocks.en: The resulting dataset follows the hierarchical organization illustrated in Fig. 3 . Starting from the rendered caustic patterns, Gaussian-blurred variants were generated to approximate reduced visibility and optical defocus. Three additional color transformations (Color 1–3) were applied using statistical color transfer in CIELAB space [ 52 ] , matching channel means and standard deviations to manually selected target appearances. These transformations introduce variability in spectral appearance and serve as empirical proxies for absorption- and turbidity-like effects. They do not constitute calibrated simulations of water-column optical properties or measured depth-dependent attenuation.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的数据集遵循图3所示的等级组织。 从成型的致癌图案开始,生成了高斯蓝调变体,以近似降低能见度和光学减焦。 使用了 CIELAB 空间中的统计色调转[52],匹配通道手段和标准偏差来进行手动选择的目标外观的另外三个颜色转换(Color 1–3). 这些变异引入了光谱外观的变异性,并成为吸收-和扰动-类似效果的经验代位. 它们不构成水柱光学特性的校准模拟或测量的深度依赖衰减。

blocks.en: Each of the 32 UAV images contributed 40 reference patches of 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixels, resulting in 1,280 reference patches. Each reference was associated with ten degraded observations: two caustic patterns, two Gaussian-blurred variants, and six color-transfer variants corresponding to three color configurations applied to both caustic patterns. The complete dataset therefore comprises 12,800 distorted–reference pairs. These augmentations increase the diversity of simulated degradation appearances without increasing the number of independent source images. The source-image-disjoint training, validation, and test partitioning protocol is described in Section III-G .
blocks.zh: 32幅无人机影像中的每一幅都贡献了40幅1000×1000×1000\time1000像素的参考补丁,产生了1,280幅参考补丁. 每种参考物都与十种退化观测物相关:两种caustic图案,两种高斯蓝调变体,以及适用于两种caustic图案的与三种颜色配置相对应的6种色调变体. 因此,完整的数据集包括12 800个扭曲的参考对。 这些增强增加了模拟降解外观的多样性,同时没有增加独立源图像的数量. 第III-G节介绍了源图像-脱节培训、验证和测试分区协议。

blocks.en: Although each degraded observation is associated with its corresponding reference patch, wave-induced refraction can introduce local geometric displacement, preventing exact feature-wise pixel correspondence. The calm-water references were acquired through water and may retain residual refraction and radiometric attenuation. No independent water-free seabed images, surveyed geometric references, or calibrated reflectance measurements are available. Consequently, KAUSTics supports supervised restoration toward a low-distortion, calm-water reference appearance. Additional dataset visualizations and rendering specifications are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 虽然每个退化的观测都与其相应的参考补丁相关,但波引起的折射可以引入局部几何位移,防止精确的特征-像素对应. 静水参照物是通过水获得的,可能保留残余折射和辐射度减弱。 没有独立的无水海底图像、测量的几何参照物或校准的反射测量。 因此,KAUSTics支持有条不紊地恢复到低沉、平静的参照物外观。 补充材料中提供了其他数据集可视化和渲染规格。

blocks.en: III-B Sea-Undistort Dataset
blocks.zh: III-B 海-未变形数据集

blocks.en: To assess the generalization of KAUSTics-Net beyond the KAUSTics dataset, we also evaluated it on Sea-Undistort [ 26 ] , a synthetic through-water benchmark developed in Blender for airborne bathymetric mapping. The dataset comprises 1,200 scenes, originally rendered as 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel RGB images. The simulated seabed includes randomized combinations of sandy flats, gravel, rocky substrates, and seagrass-like vegetation, providing a range of textures and reflectance characteristics.
blocks.zh: 为了评估KAUSTics-Net超越KAUSTics数据集的泛化,我们还在海-Undistort [26] 上评价了它,Blender公司为空中测深绘图开发了一个合成的透水基准. 数据集包含1200个场景,最初作为512×512 512\times 512像素RGB图像渲染. 模拟海床包括沙质平地,砾石,岩质底质,海草状植被的随机组合,提供了一系列纹理和反射特征.

blocks.en: For each scene, Sea-Undistort provides an original water-free reference image and multiple distorted observations generated under different water-surface and water-column conditions, including refraction, sun glint, light absorption, and turbidity-related effects. In this study, we considered three distortion configurations: all effects , no waves , and no sunglint . The all-effects configuration combines surface-wave and water-column distortions, while the other two configurations exclude the corresponding surface effect. All three share the same water-free reference image, enabling consistent evaluation across distortion conditions. Some observations exhibit strong glint and wave-induced distortions that partially or completely obscure the seabed, increasing the difficulty of restoration. Figure 4 illustrates representative scenes under the three configurations and their corresponding water-free references.
blocks.zh: 对于每个场景,海-Undistort提供了原始无水参考图像和在不同的水面和水柱条件下产生的多重扭曲观测,包括折射,日光闪烁,光吸收,以及扰动相关效应. 在这项研究中,我们考虑了三个扭曲配置:所有效果,无波,无响林. 全效构型结合了表面波和水柱的扭曲,而其他两种构型排除了相应的表面效应. 三者都拥有相同的无水参考图像,从而能够对扭曲情况进行一致评价。 一些观测显示出强烈的闪烁和波浪引起的扭曲,部分或完全模糊海底,增加了恢复的难度。 图4说明了三种配置下的代表性场景及其相应的无水参考。

blocks.en: III-C KAUSTics-Net Architecture
blocks.zh: 三-C KAUSTICS-Net 架构

blocks.en: KAUSTics-Net is a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework designed to restore shallow-water UAV imagery affected by spatially varying water-induced distortions. The architecture consists of a U-Net denoiser, a multi-scale conditional encoder, feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) residual blocks, and a cross-attention bottleneck (Fig. 5 ). The model operates directly on RGB images without a latent autoencoder or pretrained diffusion components and predicts diffusion velocity conditioned on the distorted observation.
blocks.zh: KAUSTics-Net是一个像素-空间有条件的传播框架,旨在恢复受空间不同水引起的扭曲影响的浅水无人机图像. 该架构包括一个U-Net denoiser,一个多尺度的有条件编码器,具有特征的线性调制(FiLM)剩余块,以及一个交叉注意的瓶颈(图5). 该模型直接在RGB图像上运行,没有潜在的自编码器或预先训练的传播组件,并预测以扭曲观测为条件的传播速度.

blocks.en: Let 𝐱 0 ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{x}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} denote the reference image and 𝐱 cond ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{cond}}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} its corresponding distorted observation. During training, a noisy sample 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} is generated from 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} at diffusion timestep t t , as described in Section III-D . The U-Net receives the channel-wise concatenation of 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} and 𝐱 cond \mathbf{x}_{\mathrm{cond}} , while a separate five-stage conditional encoder extracts multi-scale features from the distorted observation. The encoder uses 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions, group normalization, SiLU activations, and bilinear downsampling, with channel dimensions of 16, 32, 64, 128, and 256.

blocks.en: The extracted features condition the U-Net residual blocks through FiLM [ 53 ] . A 256-dimensional sinusoidal timestep embedding and globally pooled conditional features are projected into channel-wise scale and shift parameters, allowing the residual blocks to incorporate both the diffusion timestep and image-dependent information. blocks.en: This conditioning strategy is motivated by the combination of localized caustics and refractive distortions with broader radiometric changes in through-water imagery. Multi-scale features provide image-dependent information throughout denoising, while the bottleneck attention mechanism integrates spatial information from the distorted observation. The individual architectural components follow established diffusion and conditioning techniques; their contribution within KAUSTics-Net is examined through the ablation experiments.

blocks.en: III-F Benchmark Models and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 三-F 基准模式和评价计量

blocks.en: We benchmarked KAUSTics-Net against eight image-restoration methods spanning GAN-based architectures, underwater image enhancement, and diffusion-based restoration. The GAN-based baselines include CycleGAN [ 37 ] , UGAN [ 27 ] , FUnIE-GAN [ 38 ] , and DeWaterGAN [ 23 ] . The diffusion-based methods include DiffWater [ 28 ] and ResShift [ 48 ] . We additionally evaluated SS-UIE [ 49 ] and U-Shape Transformer [ 50 ] , which incorporate spatial–spectral modeling and transformer-based feature extraction, respectively. These methods provide complementary architectural comparisons for restoring imagery affected by spatially varying distortions. All eight baselines were trained and evaluated using the revised experimental protocol described in the following subsection.
blocks.zh: 我们以KAUSTics-Net为基准对比了八种图像恢复方法,这些方法跨越基于GAN的架构、水下图像增强以及基于扩散的恢复。 基于GAN的基线包括循环GAN [37],UGAN [27],FUNIE-GAN [38],和DeWaterGAN [23]. 基于传播的方法包括DiffWater[28]和ResShift[48]. 我们进一步评价了SS-UIE [49] 和U-Shape变形器[50],它们分别包括空间-光谱模型和变形器特性提取。 这些方法为恢复受空间差异扭曲影响的图像提供了补充性建筑比较。 所有8个基线都利用以下小节所述经修订的试验议定书进行了培训和评价。

blocks.en: Restoration fidelity was assessed using mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (mPSNR), mean structural similarity index (mSSIM), mean root mean squared error (mRMSE), and mean squared error (mMSE). We additionally included learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) [ 56 ] and CIEDE2000 ( Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} ) [ 57 ] to quantify perceptual feature differences and color discrepancies relative to the reference images. Higher values indicate better performance for mPSNR and mSSIM, while lower values are preferred for the remaining metrics. LPIPS was computed using an AlexNet backbone on 8-bit RGB outputs, and CIEDE2000 was evaluated in D65/2-degree CIELAB space.
blocks.zh: 利用平均峰值信号对噪比(mPSNR),平均结构相似性指数(mSSIM),平均根值平方差错(mRMSE)和平均平方差错(mMSE)来评估恢复忠心度. 此外,我们还包括了已学到的感知图像补丁相似性(LPIPS)[56]和CIEDE2000(Δ E 00\Delta E_{00})[57],以量化感知特征差异和与参考图像的颜色差异。 较高的数值表明mPSNR和mSSIM的性能较好,而其余的度量标准则偏好较低的值. LPIPS是在8位RGB输出上使用AlexNet主干线进行计算,CIEDE2000在D65/2度CIELAB空间中被评价.

blocks.en: No-reference image quality was evaluated using the Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) [ 58 ] , Blind/Referenceless Image Spatial Quality Evaluator (BRISQUE) [ 59 ] , Perception-based Image Quality Evaluator (PIQE) [ 60 ] , and Integrated Local NIQE (ILNIQE) [ 61 ] . These metrics assess deviations from statistical properties associated with natural images, with lower values indicating better predicted quality. Three learning-based perceptual metrics were also included: Learned Image Quality Evaluator (LIQE) [ 62 ] , CLIP-based Image Quality assessment (CLIPIQ) [ 63 ] , and Multi-scale Image Quality (MUSIQ) [ 64 ] . For MUSIQ, we report the AVA-trained variant (MUSIQ_AVA), with higher scores indicating better predicted perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: 使用自然图像质量评价器(NIQE)[58],盲/无参考图像空间质量评价器(BRISQUE)[59],感知基图像质量评价器(PIQE)[60],以及综合本地NIQE(ILNIQE)[61],对无参考图像质量进行了评价. 这些衡量标准评估了与自然图像相关的统计属性的偏差,较低的数值表明质量预测较好。 还包括三个基于学习的观念衡量标准: 学习图像质量评价师(LIQE)[62],基于CLIP的图像质量评估(CLIPIQ)[63],以及多尺度图像质量(MUSIQ)[64]. 对MUSIQ来说,我们报告AVA训练的变体(MUSIQ_AVA),更高的分数表明预知性能更好.

blocks.en: Sharpness and Shannon entropy were further computed as complementary indicators of image detail and intensity variability. Sharpness was defined as the variance of the discrete Laplacian, while entropy was calculated from the 256-bin luminance histogram. These metrics characterize changes in image structure and tonal distribution but do not independently establish restoration accuracy, as noise and artifacts can also increase their values.
blocks.zh: 锐度和香农py被进一步计算为图像细节和强度可变性的补充指标。 锐度被定义为离散的拉普拉西安的差数,而 en是从256-宾光度直方图中计算出来的. 这些度量衡特征是图像结构和肾脏分布的变化,但并不独立确定修复精度,因为噪音和文物也可以提高它们的值.

blocks.en: Finally, to investigate the potential utility of restoration for downstream UAV image analysis, we evaluated real-world examples using the Segment Anything Model (SAM) [ 65 ] and scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT) [ 66 ] , following the computer-vision assessment approach previously applied to shallow-water UAV imagery [ 12 ] . SAM was used to examine automatically generated image regions, while SIFT quantified local keypoint detection and descriptor correspondence. The real-UAV comparison used a temporal computer-vision reference from our previous work, which provides a low-distortion comparison image without constituting independently validated water-free ground truth. These analyses complement the image quality metrics by examining the preservation of local features and segmentation behavior.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了调查对下游无人驾驶飞行器图像分析进行恢复的潜在效用,我们采用了以往适用于浅水无人驾驶飞行器图像的计算机-视觉评估方法,利用“任何部分模型” [65] 和“比例变化特性变换”(SIFT) [66] 评估了真实世界的实例。 SAM被用于检查自动生成的图像区域,而SIFT则量化了本地的键点检测和描述符对应. 真实的UAV比较使用了我们以前作品中的时间计算机-视觉参考,提供了低扭曲的比较图像,而不构成独立验证的无水地面真理. 这些分析通过审查局部特征的保存和分化行为来补充图像质量衡量标准.

blocks.en: III-G Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: III-G 实验设置

blocks.en: The stored KAUSTics images were converted to RGB and normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] for training. All methods used the same 256 × 256 256\times 256 image resolution, obtained by bicubic downsampling of the original 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 patches without additional spatial cropping.
blocks.zh: 所储存的KAUSTics图像被转换为RGB,并正常化为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1]用于训练. 所有方法都使用相同的256×256256\times256图像分辨率,通过对原1000×1000\time1000补丁的双立体下取样而获得,没有额外的空间裁剪.

blocks.en: To prevent leakage between augmented observations of the same source image, the dataset was partitioned at the UAV-image level. Using a fixed random seed of 42, the 32 source images were divided into 26 training, three validation, and three test images. Every reference patch and its ten degraded variants inherited the partition of the corresponding source image. Table II summarizes the resulting dataset composition.
blocks.zh: 为了防止同一源图像的放大观测之间的渗漏,数据集被分割在无人驾驶飞行器图像级别。 使用42的固定随机种子,32个源图像分为26个训练,3个验证,3个测试图像. 每个参考补丁及其十种退化的变体都继承了相应的源图像的分区. 表二汇总了由此产生的数据集组成。

blocks.en: The partitioning protocol ensures independence of source-image identifiers across training, validation, and testing. However, geographic independence cannot be guaranteed because different UAV frames may cover overlapping seabed areas. For KAUSTics-Net, each training epoch contained 2,080 patch–shape combinations, with additional degradation variants sampled with probability 0.6. Model selection used a fixed, stratified subset of 120 validation observations evaluated through the conditional sampling procedure. The complete test set contained all 1,200 degraded observations from the three held-out UAV images.
blocks.zh: 分区协议确保源图像识别器在培训、验证和测试中的独立性。 然而,由于不同的无人驾驶航空器框架可能涵盖重叠的海底区域,因此无法保证地理独立性。 对KAUSTics-Net来说,每个培训时代包含2,080个补丁-形状组合,另外还有以概率0.6为样本的降解变体。 模型选择使用一个固定的、分层的子集,即120个通过有条件取样程序评估的验证观测。 完整的测试集包含从三个悬停的无人驾驶飞行器图像中所有1,200个退化的观测.

blocks.en: TABLE II: KAUSTics source-image splits. Each UAV image contributes 40 reference patches, with ten degraded observations per patch.
blocks.zh: 表二:KAUSTICS源图像分裂. 每个无人机图像贡献40个参考补丁,每个补丁有10个退化的观测.

blocks.en: All eight benchmark models were retrained using the same source-image partitions and evaluated on identical test observations. Their original architectures and training objectives were retained, with resource-dependent adaptations to learning rates, batch sizes, and training schedules. Benchmark training included a minimum of 100 epochs, followed by validation-based early stopping with a minimum PSNR improvement of 0.05 dB, patience of ten epochs, and a maximum of 1,000 epochs. Validation was performed every ten epochs. KAUSTics-Net was trained for 1,000 epochs, with checkpoint selection based on validation PSNR.
blocks.zh: 所有8个基准模型都使用相同的源图像分区进行再培训,并在相同的测试观测中进行评估。 他们保留了最初的架构和培训目标,根据资源情况调整学习率、批量规模和培训时间表。 基准培训包括至少100个纪元,然后基于验证的早期停止,最低PSNR改进0.05 dB,耐心10个纪元,最长1000个纪元。 每10个世纪进行一次验证。 KAUSTics-Net接受了1000个世纪的培训,根据验证的PSNR选择了检查站.

All models were independently trained using three random seeds (1–3), and results are reported as the mean and standard deviation across seeds. Differences in architectures, GPU hardware, and training schedules mean that the reported runtimes do not constitute a matched-compute comparison. Additional model-specific implementation details are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: III-H Sea-Undistort Adaptation Protocol
blocks.zh: III-H 《海洋与历史的适应议定书》

blocks.en: To investigate cross-dataset transfer, KAUSTics-Net was first evaluated on Sea-Undistort without additional training. We subsequently fine-tuned the KAUSTics-trained model using the existing scene-disjoint partition of 840 training, 240 validation, and 120 test scenes. Fine-tuning used the all-effects observations, while evaluation covered the all-effects, no-waves, and no-sunglint configurations. Each distorted observation was compared against its corresponding original water-free reference image, and the same scene identifiers were maintained across configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了调查跨数据集传输,KAUSTics-Net首次在海-Undistort上进行了评价,但没有接受更多培训. 我们随后对KAUSTics训练型号进行了微调,采用了现有840次训练、240次验证和120次试验场景的场景-分裂分区。 微调使用全效观测,而评价则涵盖全效,无波,无星林配置. 每一次扭曲的观测都与其对应的原始无水参考图像进行了比较,并维持了不同配置的相同场景标识.

blocks.en: All eight benchmark methods were fine-tuned from their corresponding seed-specific, validation-selected KAUSTics checkpoints, with optimizer states reinitialized. Training used only the all-effects observations from the 840 Sea-Undistort training scenes, with the original water-free references; CycleGAN and DeWaterGAN retained their unpaired objectives using independently sampled clean images from the same training pool. Each baseline completed 100 epochs at a constant learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , retaining its method-specific objective and batch size. Checkpoints were selected by mean SSIM on the 240 all-effects validation scenes, with the initial checkpoint remaining eligible. DiffWater used less frequent validation after its initial checks because of the computational cost of diffusion sampling. All methods were evaluated using three corresponding training seeds on the same 120 held-out scenes under the three distortion configurations. Complete optimization and checkpoint-selection details are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 所有八种基准方法都从相应的种子特异性,验证性选择的KAUSTics检查站进行了微调,优化状态重新启动. 训练只使用了来自840海-未变形训练场景的全效观测结果,原无水参考; CycleGAN和DeWaterGAN使用同一训练池中独立取样的清洁图像保留了未变形的目标. 每个基准以10 - 5 10 - 5 5 的一贯学习速度完成了100个纪元,保留其方法特定目标和批量规模。 在240个全效验证场景上,通过平均值SSIM选择了检查站,最初的检查站仍符合资格. DiffWater在进行初步检查后,由于扩散取样的计算成本,采用了较少的验证. 在三个扭曲布局下,在相同的120个搁置场景上使用三个相应的培训种子对所有方法进行了评价。 补充材料提供了完整的优化和检查站选择细节。

blocks.en: Fine-tuning retained the original architecture and training objective, supplemented by a sampler-aware reconstruction loss. Every fourth optimizer update included an additional loss computed from the restored output of the 25-step DDIM sampling procedure: ℒ adapt = 0.8 ​ ℒ RGB + 0.2 ​ ℒ SSIM + 0.2 ​ ℒ Lab , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{adapt}}=0.8\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{RGB}}+0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SSIM}}+0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Lab}}, (4) where the RGB, SSIM, and CIELAB terms are defined in Section III-E . To limit memory consumption, gradients were propagated through only the final four sampling steps, with the preceding 21 steps detached. This provides a truncated gradient approximation of the inference procedure.
blocks.zh: 微调保留了原有的建筑和培训目标,补充的是采样器-意识重建损失. 每四个优化器更新一次,就包括从25步DDIM取样程序的恢复产出中计算的额外损失: L 适应 = 0.8 L RGB + 0.2 L SSIM + 0.2 L Lab ,\ mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm {adapt}}= 0.8\,\mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm {RGB}}+ 0.2\,\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm {Lab}}, (4) 第三-E节界定了RGB、SSIM和CIELAB等术语。 为了限制内存消耗,只通过最后四个采样步骤传播梯度,前21个步骤脱落. 这提供了推论程序的短长梯度近似.

blocks.en: Optimization used AdamW with a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size of 12, and conditioning dropout probability of 0.1. Fine-tuning was limited to 100 epochs, with checkpoints selected according to mean validation SSIM across all 240 validation scenes. Validation was performed at epochs 0 and 1 and subsequently every five epochs. The sampling configuration remained unchanged, using strength 0.95 and classifier-free guidance scale 2.

blocks.en: The adaptation experiments were conducted using three independent training seeds. Since the expanded evaluation followed inspection of preliminary test results, these experiments are treated as exploratory. The zero-shot results are reported separately in the supplementary material to distinguish performance without adaptation from improvements obtained through dataset-specific fine-tuning.

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents a qualitative comparison of the restoration methods on ten selected patches from the held-out KAUSTics test set, covering the two caustic patterns and their corresponding blur and color-transfer variants. All methods were evaluated on identical inputs, allowing direct visual comparison of distortion suppression, color reconstruction, and preservation of seabed textures.
blocks.zh: 图6从质量上比较了从被搁置的KAUSTics测试集中选取的十个补丁的恢复方法,涵盖了两种致病模式及其相应的模糊和色转移变体. 对所有方法都进行了同样的评价,从而可以直接直观地比较扭曲抑制、颜色重建以及海底纹理的保存。

blocks.en: The GAN-based methods exhibited varying restoration characteristics. CycleGAN and UGAN reduced some distortions but retained visible differences in color and local structure relative to the reference images. FUnIE-GAN enhanced local contrast, occasionally introducing pronounced edges and high-frequency artifacts, while DeWaterGAN produced smoother appearances in several regions. Among the remaining baselines, DiffWater and ResShift recovered some structural details, although differences in texture and radiometric appearance remained. SS-UIE and U-Shape Transformer also demonstrated distinct restoration behaviors, particularly in areas containing complex seabed textures and spatially varying distortions.
blocks.zh: 基于GAN的方法显示出不同的恢复特性。 CycleGAN和UGAN减少了一些扭曲,但相对于参考图像在颜色和局部结构上保留了明显的差异. FUNIE-GAN增强了本地的对比度,偶尔会引入显著的边缘和高频文物,而DeWaterGAN则在多个区域产生更平滑的外观. 在剩余的基线中,DiffWater和ResShift发现了一些结构细节,尽管纹理和辐射度外观仍有差异. SS-UIE和U-Shape变形器也表现出了独特的恢复行为,特别是在包含复杂海底纹理和空间变化扭曲的区域。

blocks.en: KAUSTics-Net generally produced reconstructions with reduced caustic patterns and improved correspondence to the reference appearance, while retaining recognizable sandy, rocky, and vegetated structures. Differences between methods were particularly visible in regions affected by strong illumination variations and color alterations. These examples illustrate restoration behavior across the selected degradation configurations; the quantitative results provide the broader assessment over the complete held-out test set.
blocks.zh: KAUSTics-Net 通常生产重建,减少致病模式,改进与参考外观的对应,同时保留可识别的沙质、岩石和植被结构。 在受强烈照明变化和色调改变影响的地区,方法之间的差异尤其明显。 这些例子说明了整个选定的退化配置的恢复行为;定量结果提供了对完整的搁置测试集的更广泛的评估。

blocks.en: Among the competing methods, ResShift achieved the second-highest mean PSNR ( 30.346 ± 0.513 30.346\pm 0.513 dB) and a competitive LPIPS of 0.151 ± 0.007 0.151\pm 0.007 , while U-Shape Transformer obtained the second-highest SSIM ( 0.844 ± 0.016 0.844\pm 0.016 ). blocks.en: The no-reference results in Table IV show a more heterogeneous ranking. KAUSTics-Net achieved the lowest PIQE ( 5.950 ± 1.115 5.950\pm 1.115 ), while other methods obtained better scores on several naturalness-based and learned perceptual metrics. For example, FUnIE-GAN achieved the lowest BRISQUE ( 10.779 ± 0.399 10.779\pm 0.399 ), ResShift obtained the highest LIQE ( 1.568 ± 0.023 1.568\pm 0.023 ), and SS-UIE led CLIPIQ ( 0.403 ± 0.004 0.403\pm 0.004 ) and MUSIQ_AVA ( 3.373 ± 0.021 3.373\pm 0.021 ). KAUSTics-Net therefore did not consistently outperform competing methods in predicted natural-image quality.

KAUSTics-Net因此在预测自然成像质量方面并没有一贯的超越竞争方法.

blocks.en: The differences between full-reference and no-reference metrics highlight the importance of evaluating restoration using complementary criteria. The full-reference results favor KAUSTics-Net in reconstructing the paired calm-water targets, whereas no-reference metrics produce different rankings based on their underlying image-quality assumptions. Sharpness and entropy provide additional information about edge content and intensity variability, but their values may also increase because of noise or restoration artifacts. Overall, KAUSTics-Net demonstrates strong reconstruction performance on the held-out KAUSTics data, with remaining differences between reference fidelity and predicted perceptual naturalness.
blocks.zh: 全面参考和无参考指标之间的差异突出表明了利用补充标准评估恢复的重要性。 全面参考结果有利于KAUSTics-Net重建配对的镇静水目标,而无参考指标则根据其基本图像质量假设产生不同的排名。 锐度和 en提供了边缘含量和强度可变性的更多信息,但其值也可能因为噪音或修复文物而增加. 总体而言,KAUSTics-Net在被搁置的KAUSTics数据上显示出强劲的重建表现,参考忠诚度和预测的知觉自然度之间仍然存在差异。

blocks.en: IV-B Results on the Sea-Undistort Dataset

blocks.en: We next evaluated the restoration methods on Sea-Undistort, which includes more severe combinations of water-surface and water-column distortions. Figure 7 presents representative results from the held-out test set under the all-effects, no-waves, and no-sunglint configurations. These conditions allow the visual assessment of restoration performance under different combinations of refraction, surface reflections, and radiometric degradation.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们评价了海-地下结构的修复方法,其中包括水面和水柱扭曲的更严重组合。 图7显示了在全能、无波和无星林配置下设定的暂停试验结果。 这些条件允许在折射、表面反射和辐射度降解的不同组合下对恢复性能进行视觉评估。

blocks.en: The evaluated methods exhibited different restoration characteristics. The GAN-based models generally modified the color and contrast of distorted observations but retained visible artifacts or introduced smoothing in several regions. DiffWater, ResShift, SS-UIE, and U-Shape Transformer recovered different levels of structural detail, although reconstruction quality varied with distortion severity. Following dataset-specific adaptation, KAUSTics-Net reduced several visible surface-related artifacts and improved the overall correspondence with the reference appearance. However, some reconstructed regions remained smoother than the original references, particularly where strong distortions obscured fine seabed features. These examples illustrate the remaining challenges of recovering information under severe through-water degradation.
blocks.zh: 评估的方法显示出不同的恢复特征。 基于GAN的模型一般修改了扭曲观测的颜色和对比度,但保留了可见的文物或者在几个区域引入了平滑. DiffWater,ResShift,SS-UIE,和U-Shape变形器恢复了不同层次的结构细节,虽然重建质量随扭曲的严重程度而变化. 在对数据集进行特定调整后,KAUSTics-Net减少了几件与表面有关的可见文物,并改善了与参考外观的总体对应关系。 然而,一些重建区域仍然比最初的提法更平稳,特别是在强烈扭曲掩盖了细细的海底特征的地方。 这些例子说明在严重水流退化的情况下恢复信息仍然面临挑战。

blocks.en: The full-reference results in Table VI show that KAUSTics-Net achieved the highest mean PSNR and SSIM across all three configurations. Under all effects, it obtained 19.469 ± 0.332 19.469\pm 0.332 dB PSNR and 0.554 ± 0.005 0.554\pm 0.005 SSIM, compared with 10.257 10.257 dB and 0.311 0.311 for the unprocessed input. KAUSTics-Net also achieved the lowest mean Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} across the three configurations, indicating improved color agreement with the synthetic references.

These findings indicate that the improvements in pixel-wise fidelity and structural similarity were accompanied by differences in perceptual feature reconstruction.
blocks.zh: ResShift提供了最强的相互竞争的全参考结果,在所有效果下分别达到18.022±0.095 18.022\pm 0.095,19.440±0.057 19.440\pm 0.057,18.414±0.15 18.414\pm 0.15 dB,无波,无弹簧. 然而,ResShift始终实现了比KAUSTics-Net(0.474 0.474、0.370 0.370和0.437 0.437)更低的LPIPS值(0.288 0.288、0.223 0.223和0.265 0.4)。 这些调查结果表明,在对像素保持忠诚和结构相似性进行改进的同时,还出现了观念特征重建的差异。

blocks.en: The no-reference results in Table VII showed more heterogeneous rankings. Under the all-effects configuration, CycleGAN obtained the lowest NIQE ( 6.071 ± 0.330 6.071\pm 0.330 ), DiffWater the lowest PIQE ( 5.120 ± 0.439 5.120\pm 0.439 ), and ResShift the highest LIQE ( 2.425 ± 0.003 2.425\pm 0.003 ) and CLIPIQ ( 0.522 ± 0.003 0.522\pm 0.003 ). KAUSTics-Net did not consistently lead these metrics, despite its superior full-reference reconstruction scores. Similar differences were observed under the no-waves and no-sunglint conditions.
blocks.zh: 表七的无参考结果显示,排名差异较大。 在全效配置下,CycleGAN获得了最低的NIQE(6.071±0.330 6.071\pm 0.330),Diffwater获得了最低的PIQE(5.120±0.439 5.120\pm 04.39),ResShift获得了最高的LIQE(2.425±0.003 2.425\pm 0.003)和CLIPIQ(0.522±0.003 0.522\pm 0.003). KAUSTics-Net尽管其优异的全参考重建分数,但并没有始终领先这些指标. 在无波和无星林条件下也观察到类似的差异。

blocks.en: Overall, the adapted KAUSTics-Net achieved stronger agreement with the original water-free references in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} across all three configurations. The lower LPIPS values obtained by ResShift and the mixed no-reference rankings highlight remaining perceptual differences. These results demonstrate the benefits of dataset-specific adaptation while emphasizing the need to consider complementary fidelity and perceptual metrics when evaluating through-water image restoration.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,经过改造的KAUSTics-Net在PSNR,SSIM,以及QQ E 00\Delta E_{00}三个配置方面与最初的无水参考达成了更强烈的一致. ResShift获得的较低LPIPS值和混合的无参考排名凸显了仍然存在的认知差异. 这些结果显示了针对数据集的调整的好处,同时强调需要在评估透水图像恢复时考虑互补的忠诚度和知觉度量。

blocks.en: IV-C Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 四-C 读取研究

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of individual architectural components and training objectives, we conducted an ablation study on the KAUSTics dataset. Each configuration was evaluated on the same 1,200 held-out observations across three independent training seeds. Table VIII reports the effects of removing FiLM, cross-attention, the conditional encoder, and individual reconstruction losses, using the full KAUSTics-Net configuration as the reference.
blocks.zh: 为了评估单个建筑构件和培训目标的贡献,我们对KAUSTics数据集进行了扩展研究。 在对三个独立培训种子进行同样的1 200个搁置观察的基础上,对每个组合进行了评价。 表八以完整的KAUSTics-Net配置作为参考,报告删除FiLM,交叉注意,有条件编码器,以及个人重建损失的影响.

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Ablation study of KAUSTics-Net on 1,200 held-out KAUSTics observations. Results are reported as mean ± \pm standard deviation across three training seeds. Individual architectural components and loss terms are removed while retaining the remaining configuration. The component ablations use guidance scale 2, while the matched conditioning-dropout comparison uses guidance scale 1 for both configurations. Bold values indicate the best mean within each comparison block.
blocks.zh: 表八:KAUSTics-Net关于1,200个搁置的KAUSTics观测结果的研究。 结果报告为三个培训种子的平均±\pm标准差。 单个建筑构件和损失条款在保留剩余配置的同时被删除. 组件缩放使用2级指导,而匹配的调制-跳出比较则使用2级指导。 粗体值表示每个比较区块中的最佳平均值。

blocks.en: Among the architectural components, removing FiLM or the conditional encoder slightly reduced the mean PSNR and SSIM, indicating a modest benefit from multi-scale conditioning. Removing cross-attention produced a marginally higher PSNR (31.813 versus 31.715 dB) but lower SSIM (0.846 versus 0.849). These differences were small relative to the variability across seeds, suggesting that the contributions of individual conditioning mechanisms are not consistently reflected across all metrics.
blocks.zh: 在建筑构件中,去除FiLM或有条件的编码器略微降低了平均值PSNR和SSIM,表明从多尺度调制中得益不大. 取消交叉拨款产生的PSNR(31.813比31.715 dB)略高,但SSIM(0.846比0.849)。 这些差异与不同种子的变异性相比很小,表明个别调节机制的贡献并非在所有衡量标准中都得到一致反映。

blocks.en: The most pronounced degradation occurred when removing the SSIM loss, which reduced PSNR from 31.715 to 29.994 dB and SSIM from 0.849 to 0.821, while increasing LPIPS from 0.145 to 0.166 and Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} from 3.080 to 3.660. This indicates that structural supervision plays an important role in the reconstruction objective. In contrast, removing the low-frequency, UV, RGB reconstruction, or CIELAB loss produced mixed results, with some configurations improving individual metrics. For example, removing the UV loss increased PSNR to 32.181 dB, while removing the CIELAB loss slightly improved SSIM to 0.851. These findings indicate that the complete loss formulation does not optimize every metric individually.
blocks.zh: 最显著的降解发生在去除SSIM损失时,PSNR从31.715降至29.994 dB,SSIM从0.849降至0.821,同时将LPIPS从0.145增至0.166,QQE 00\Delta E_{00}从3.080增至3.660. 这表明,结构监督在重建目标中发挥着重要作用。 相比之下,去除低频,紫外线,RGB重建,或CIELAB损失产生的结果好坏参半,一些配置改进了个人的度量. 例如,去除紫外线损失将PSNR提高到32.181 dB,同时去除CIELAB损失略微改进为0.851. 这些调查结果表明,完整的损失配方并没有对每个计量进行优化。

blocks.en: Conditioning dropout was evaluated separately using a matched classifier-free guidance scale of 1 for both configurations. Removing dropout preserved the mean SSIM (0.849) while improving PSNR, LPIPS, and Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} . Thus, the ablation does not establish an independent advantage from conditioning dropout under this sampling configuration.
blocks.zh: 使用两个配置的匹配的无分类器指导尺度1,分别评价了条件退出。 取消退学保留了平均值SSIM(0. 849),同时改进了PSNR,LPIPS,和QQ E 00\Delta E_{00}. 因此,在这种抽样结构下,取消资格并不能确立对辍学进行调节的独立优势。

blocks.en: Overall, the ablation results identify the SSIM loss as the component with the clearest contribution to reconstruction performance. The remaining architectural and loss components exhibit smaller or metric-dependent effects, highlighting the importance of assessing the proposed configuration across multiple restoration criteria.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,削减结果将SSIM损失确定为对重建业绩有最明确贡献的组成部分。 其余的建筑和损失部分显示出较小或取决于衡量的效果,突出了评估拟议配置在多种恢复标准方面的重要性。

blocks.en: IV-D Real-UAV Downstream Evaluation
blocks.zh: IV-D 实际无人驾驶飞行器 下游评价

blocks.en: To examine the behavior of the restoration methods on real through-water imagery, we conducted an exploratory case study using a UAV frame from the controlled shallow-water survey of Scilla et al. [ 12 ] . The comparison reference was generated using the temporal computer-vision correction approach developed in that study, which combines information from 60 consecutive frames. This image provides a low-distortion visual reference but does not constitute independently validated water-free ground truth. Two regions containing a ground control point (GCP) and a bucket, located at approximately 0.600 and 0.900 m water depth, respectively, were selected for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了审查修复方法在真实的透水图象上的行为,我们利用Scilla等人控制的浅水调查中的无人驾驶航空器框架进行了一次探索性案例研究。 [12]. 比较参考是利用该研究中开发的时间计算机视觉校正方法生成的,该方法结合了60个连续帧的信息。 这个图像提供了低扭曲的视觉参考,但并不构成独立验证的无水地面真象. 选定了两个区域,其中地面控制点和水桶分别位于水深约0.600和0.900米。

blocks.en: All restoration methods were applied to identical 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixel image contexts resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels, using their Sea-Undistort-adapted seed-1 checkpoints without further training. To reduce differences in large-scale color appearance, the model outputs received the same low-frequency color harmonization based on the distorted input, using a Gaussian smoothing scale of σ = 5 \sigma=5 pixels and correction strength α = 1 \alpha=1 . The input and temporal reference remained unchanged, and no geometric registration was applied. This processing was specific to the real-UAV case study and was not used in the quantitative benchmark evaluations.
blocks.zh: 所有修复方法都应用于相同的1000×1000×1000×1000×时1000像素图像环境调整为256×256×时256像素,使用其海-不扭曲改造的种子-1检查站,无需再培训. 为了减少大规模颜色外观的差异,模型输出在扭曲输入的基础上得到了相同的低频颜色协调,使用高斯平滑尺度==5\sigma=5像素,修正强度α=1\alpha=1. 投入和时间参考保持不变,没有进行几何登记。 这种处理是真实的无人驾驶飞行器个案研究所特有的,没有用于定量基准评价。

blocks.en: Figure 8 compares automatic segmentation regions produced by the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and local features detected using the scale-invariant feature transform (SIFT). SAM ViT-B was applied with a 32 × 32 32\times 32 point grid, predicted-IoU threshold of 0.88, and stability threshold of 0.95. SIFT used a contrast threshold of 0.040, with identical detector settings across all images. These diagnostics characterize segmentation behavior and local feature detection without requiring manually annotated object masks.
blocks.zh: 图8比较了分块任意模式(SAM)产生的自动分块区域,以及使用比例变化特性变换(SIFT)检测到的局部特性. SAM VIT-B的应用采用32×32 32\时32点网格,预测-IoU阈值0.88,稳定性阈值0.95. SIFT采用了0.040的对比阈值,在所有图像上都有相同的探测器设置. 这些诊断特征为分割行为和局部特征检测,不需要手动附加说明的物体口罩.

blocks.en: Fig. 8: Real-UAV structural diagnostics for the GCP (0.600 m depth) and bucket (0.900 m depth). Columns show the temporal computer-vision reference, distorted input, and eight benchmark restorations alongside KAUSTics-Net. Each object is evaluated using SAM segmentation regions and SIFT keypoints. All model outputs receive identical low-frequency color harmonization ( α = 1 \alpha=1 , σ = 5 \sigma=5 pixels), while the input and reference remain unchanged. Red boxes identify corresponding object-centered regions, and insets enlarge these regions for visualization. Histograms show the spatial distribution of SIFT keypoints using 20 bins and a common count scale within each object. SAM colors distinguish automatically generated regions and do not represent semantic classes. All methods use identical SAM and SIFT settings.
blocks.zh: 图8:用于GCP(0.600米深度)和桶(0.900米深度)的Real-UAV结构诊断. 列显示时间计算机视觉参考,扭曲输入,和与KAUSTics-Net并列的8个基准恢复. 每个对象都使用 SAM 分割区域和 SIFT 键点来评价. 所有模型输出都得到相同的低频颜色协调(α=1\alpha=1,σ=5\sigma=5像素),而输入和引用则保持不变. 红盒识别出相应的以物体为中心的区域,内置物会扩大这些区域进行可视化. 直方图显示SIFT键点的空间分布,使用20个bin和每个物体内部的通用计数尺度. SAM颜色自动区分生成区域,不代表语义类. 所有方法都使用相同的SAM和SIFT设置.

blocks.en: For the GCP region, SIFT detected 92 keypoints in the distorted input, 219 in the KAUSTics-Net reconstruction, and 874 in the temporal reference. The corresponding counts for the bucket were 19, 152, and 347. Although KAUSTics-Net increased the number of detected features relative to the distorted input, substantial differences remained compared with the reference. Other restoration methods exhibited different feature densities, demonstrating that the effect of image restoration on keypoint detection depends on the model and scene content.
blocks.zh: 对于GCP区域,SIFT在扭曲输入中检测到92个关键点,在KAUSTics-Net重建中检测到219个,在时间参考中检测到874个. 相应的桶数为19,152,347. 尽管KAUSTics-Net相对于扭曲输入增加了检测到的特性数量,但与参考文献相比,仍然存在实质性差异。 其他恢复方法表现出不同的特征密度,表明图像恢复对关键点检测的影响取决于模型和场景内容.

blocks.en: To further examine feature correspondence, Fig. 9 compares SIFT descriptor matches between the restored images and the temporal reference. Using mutual nearest-neighbor matching with a bidirectional ratio threshold of 0.75, KAUSTics-Net produced five putative matches for the GCP, compared with three for the distorted input, and one for the bucket, compared with none for the input. UGAN produced ten matches in each region, while DiffWater produced no matches despite detecting local features. These results indicate that increased keypoint density does not necessarily correspond to increased descriptor agreement with the reference.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步检查特征对应,图9比较了SIFT描述符在恢复的图像和时间参考之间的匹配. KAUSTics-Net采用近邻相互比对,双向比阈值为0.75,为GCP生产了5个假配对,而扭曲输入为3个,桶为1个,而输入为0个。 UGAN在每个地区生产了10个火柴,而DiffWater尽管检测到了本地的特性,但没有生产火柴. 这些结果表明,键点密度的提高不一定与对参考文献的描述性增加一致。

blocks.en: Fig. 9: SIFT feature correspondence between the distorted input or restored GCP images and the temporal computer-vision reference. Each panel shows the evaluated image on the left and the common reference on the right. Orange lines indicate mutual nearest-neighbor descriptor matches obtained using a bidirectional ratio threshold of 0.75. SIFT features were extracted with a contrast threshold of 0.040. Match counts represent putative correspondences without RANSAC-based geometric verification. No spatial registration was applied to the restored images.
blocks.zh: 费格。 9: SIFT在扭曲的输入或恢复的GCP图像与时间计算机-视觉参考之间的对应功能. 每个面板显示左边的评价图像和右边的共同参考. 橙线表示使用0.75的双向比阈值获得的近邻对称匹配. SIFT的特性被提取,对比阈值为0.040. 匹配计数代表没有基于RANSAC的几何校验的假定函证. 未对恢复的图像进行空间登记。

blocks.en: The SAM results also varied among methods, with changes in the number and spatial distribution of automatically generated regions (Fig. 8 ). However, these regions do not represent validated semantic classes, and no independent segmentation annotations were available to quantify accuracy. Similarly, the SIFT correspondences were not geometrically verified using RANSAC or an equivalent consistency test. Consequently, the observed changes cannot establish improvements in object localization, geometric reconstruction, or habitat mapping accuracy.
blocks.zh: SAM的结果也因方法而异,自动生成区域的数量和空间分布的变化(图8). 然而,这些区域并不代表经过验证的语义类,也没有独立的分区说明来量化准确性. 同样,SIFT通信也没有使用RANSAC或等效一致性测试进行几何验证. 因此,所观察到的变化无法改善物体的定位、几何重建或生境绘图准确性。

blocks.en: Overall, this case study illustrates how restoration can alter the outputs of subsequent computer-vision operations on real UAV imagery. The results are descriptive and limited to two selected regions from one survey frame. A broader evaluation with independent geometric measurements and annotated seabed features is required to determine whether these changes translate into improved remote-sensing products.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本案例研究说明了恢复如何改变随后在真实的无人驾驶飞行器图像上计算机视觉操作的输出。 调查结果是描述性的,仅限于从一个调查框架中选定的两个区域。 为了确定这些变化是否转化为改进的遥感产品,需要进行具有独立几何测量和附加说明的海底特征的更广泛的评价。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: V-A Generalization and Limitations
blocks.zh: V-A 概括和限制

blocks.en: Obtaining paired distorted and reference UAV imagery of the same shallow-water scene remains challenging because water-surface conditions can change rapidly, while repeated acquisitions under comparable illumination, tide, and viewing geometry are difficult to achieve. Consequently, learning-based restoration methods frequently rely on synthetic data, unpaired training, or domain adaptation [ 67 , 68 , 69 , 70 ] . KAUSTics addresses this data limitation by combining real UAV imagery with rendered caustics and refraction, complemented by empirical color-transfer and blur augmentations. This approach enables controlled restoration experiments while retaining the textures and spatial characteristics of real shallow-water UAV observations [ 16 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 获取同一浅水场景的成对和参照的无人驾驶航空器图像仍然具有挑战性,因为水面条件可以迅速变化,而根据可比较的照明、潮汐和取景几何方法的反复获取则难以实现。 因此,基于学习的恢复方法往往依赖于合成数据、未经认证的培训或域内适应[67、68、69、70]。 KAUSTics通过将真实的无人驾驶飞行器图像与制成的致癌物和折射物结合起来,辅之以经验性色传导和模糊的增强,来解决这一数据限制. 这种方法可以进行有控制的恢复实验,同时保留真实浅水无人驾驶航空器观测的纹理和空间特征[16、12]。

blocks.en: The revised evaluation demonstrates improved reconstruction fidelity on held-out KAUSTics images and substantial gains following adaptation to Sea-Undistort. However, these findings have distinct implications for generalization. The KAUSTics test set contains 1,200 degraded observations derived from only three source UAV images, and the source-image-disjoint partition does not guarantee geographic independence between potentially overlapping survey footprints. Similarly, the Sea-Undistort experiments evaluate one independently generated synthetic dataset, with the main improvements obtained after dataset-specific fine-tuning. These results establish performance under the evaluated conditions but do not demonstrate reliable zero-shot transfer to arbitrary coastal environments, sensors, or acquisition geometries.
blocks.zh: 订正评价显示,在适应海洋历史之后,被搁置的KAUSTics图像的重建更加忠实,并取得了重大成果。 然而,这些结论对概括具有明显的影响。 KAUSTics测试集包含只有3个来源的无人驾驶飞行器图像产生的1200个退化观测数据,源-图像-离子分割并不能保证可能重叠的勘测足迹之间的地理独立性. 同样,Sea-Undistort实验评价一个独立生成的合成数据集,主要改进是在数据集特定微调后取得的. 这些结果确定了在评价条件下的性能,但没有表明可靠的零射转动到任意的沿海环境、传感器或获取的几何仪。

blocks.en: Additional limitations arise from the dataset construction. The KAUSTics reference images were acquired through water under relatively calm conditions and may retain residual geometric and radiometric distortions. Furthermore, the Blender simulations use planar seabed textures and selected water-surface configurations, while blur and color transfer provide empirical approximations of water-column degradation. The resulting observations do not reproduce the complete interaction between three-dimensional bathymetry, water constituents, multiple scattering, and sensor radiometry. Consequently, reconstruction accuracy is measured relative to the available reference appearance, and the recovery of absolute seabed geometry or intrinsic reflectance remains unverified.
blocks.zh: 数据集的构建也造成了其他限制。 KAUSTics的参考图像是在相对平静的条件下通过水获取的,并可能保留残留的几何和辐射扭曲. 此外,Blender模拟利用了浮游海底纹理和选定的水面布局,而模糊和颜色转移则提供了水柱退化的经验近似值。 由此得出的观测结果不会复制三维水深测量、水成分、多重散射和传感器辐射测量之间的完全相互作用。 因此,根据现有的参考外观衡量重建的准确性,绝对海床几何或内在反射的恢复仍未核实。

blocks.en: Severe distortions introduce a further limitation because sun glint, scattering, and wave-induced displacement can obscure information needed for faithful reconstruction [ 26 ] . Learning-based models may generate plausible structures in regions where the observations provide insufficient evidence, potentially reflecting correlations learned from the training distribution [ 71 , 72 ] . This risk reinforces the importance of evaluating restored imagery against independent geometric and ecological measurements before using it for quantitative remote-sensing applications.
blocks.zh: 严重扭曲造成了进一步的限制,因为太阳闪烁、散射和波浪引起的流离失所可能掩盖忠实重建所需的信息[26]。 以学习为基础的模型可能会在观测结果提供不充分证据的地区产生可信的结构,可能反映从培训分配中吸取的关联性[71、72]。 这一风险加强了在利用恢复图像进行定量遥感应用之前对照独立的几何和生态测量进行评估的重要性。

blocks.en: V-B Perceptual Metrics, Pixel Fidelity, and Task Utility
blocks.zh: V-B 感知量表、像素Fidelity和任务工具

blocks.en: The revised experiments highlight differences between reconstruction fidelity and predicted perceptual quality. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved the highest mean PSNR and SSIM and the lowest LPIPS and Δ ​ E 00 \Delta E_{00} among the evaluated methods. Following Sea-Undistort adaptation, it also obtained the highest PSNR and SSIM across all three distortion configurations. However, the no-reference rankings remained heterogeneous, and ResShift consistently achieved lower LPIPS on Sea-Undistort. These findings indicate that improvements in pixel-level similarity, perceptual feature agreement, and natural-image statistics do not necessarily coincide, consistent with limitations reported in underwater image quality assessment [ 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 订正实验突出了重建忠贞与预测的知觉质量之间的差异。 在KAUSTics上,KAUSTics-Net在评估的方法中实现了最高的平均值PSNR和SSIM,最低的LPIPS和QQ E 00\Delta E_{00}. 在Sea-Undistort改编后,它也获得了所有三种扭曲配置中最高的PSNR和SSIM. 然而,无参考文献的排名仍然参差不齐,ResShift在Sea-Undistort上始终实现了较低的LPIPS. 这些调查结果表明,在像素水平相似性、感知特征协议和自然图像统计方面的改进不一定一致,这与水下图像质量评估报告的限制相一致[73]。

blocks.en: The component ablations further clarify these results. Removing the SSIM loss produced the most pronounced degradation across the evaluated fidelity and perceptual metrics, supporting its contribution to the reconstruction objective. In contrast, removing individual conditioning mechanisms or other loss terms produced smaller and sometimes favorable changes in specific metrics. The complete architecture therefore represents one experimentally evaluated configuration, without establishing that every component independently contributes to all aspects of restoration quality.
blocks.zh: 该部分进一步澄清了这些结果。 消除SSIM损失在评估的忠诚度和知觉度量中产生了最明显的退化,支持了它对重建目标的贡献。 与此相反,取消个别的调节机制或其他损失条件对具体衡量标准产生了较小的、有时是有利的变化。 因此,完整的架构代表一个试验性评价的配置,而没有确定每个组件都独立地对修复质量的各个方面作出贡献。

blocks.en: For shallow-water remote sensing, improved image quality is valuable only when relevant scene information is preserved. Accurate feature correspondence, object localization, habitat interpretation, and bathymetric reconstruction depend on geometric consistency and reliable seabed information [ 16 , 12 ] . The real-UAV case study illustrates this distinction: restoration altered SIFT keypoint density and SAM segmentation behavior, but the number of repeatable descriptor matches with the temporal computer-vision reference remained limited. Moreover, the SAM regions lacked independent semantic annotations, and the feature matches were not geometrically verified. The results therefore demonstrate changes in downstream computer-vision outputs without establishing improvements in mapping accuracy. Future task-oriented evaluations should incorporate annotated habitat boundaries, independently surveyed features, or validated bathymetric measurements.
blocks.zh: 就浅水遥感而言,只有当相关场景信息得到保存时,改善图像质量才有价值。 准确的特征对应,物体定位,栖息地解释,以及测深重建取决于几何一致性和可靠的海底信息[16,12]. 真-UAV案例研究说明了这种区别:恢复改变的SIFT键点密度和SAM分割行为,但可重复描述符与时间计算机-视觉参考匹配的数量仍然有限. 此外,SAM地区缺乏独立的语义说明,特征匹配没有几何验证. 因此,这些结果显示下游计算机-视觉产出的变化,而没有改进绘图的准确性。 今后以任务为导向的评价应包括附加说明的生境界限、独立调查的特征或经验证的测深测量。

blocks.en: V-C Practical Considerations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 五-C 实际考虑和未来方向

blocks.en: KAUSTics-Net integrates established conditional diffusion components within a restoration framework designed for through-water UAV imagery. Its contribution lies in the combination of semi-synthetic data construction, multi-scale conditioning, and a composite reconstruction objective evaluated under controlled degradation settings. The ablation study provides partial support for these design choices, with the clearest benefit associated with structural supervision. Additional experiments are required to isolate the effects of individual conditioning mechanisms and determine their contributions under different training conditions.
blocks.zh: KAUSTics-Net在为透水无人驾驶飞行器图像设计的恢复框架内,将已确定的有条件扩散组件整合起来。 它的贡献在于结合半合成数据构建,多尺度的调制,以及一个在可控降解环境下评价的综合重建目标. 消化研究为这些设计选择提供了部分支持,与结构监督相关的效益最为明显. 还需要进行更多的实验,以隔离个别调节机制的影响,并确定它们在不同培训条件下的贡献。

blocks.en: Computational requirements also affect practical applicability. Although all methods were evaluated at a common 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution, differences in training schedules, optimization procedures, and GPU hardware prevent a strictly matched-compute comparison. KAUSTics-Net required approximately 0.367 s per image for inference on an NVIDIA A100 GPU, excluding metric computation. Its iterative sampling procedure introduces additional considerations for processing large UAV surveys, particularly when preserving the native spatial resolution of high-resolution acquisitions. Comparisons under matched computational budgets and evaluation at larger image resolutions would help establish the trade-offs between restoration quality and operational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 计算要求也影响到实际适用性。 虽然所有方法都以256×256256\times 256分辨率来评价,但是在训练时间表,优化程序,和GPU硬件上的差异阻止了严格匹配的比较. KAUSTics-Net每幅图像需要大约0.367s,才能推断出一个NVIDIA A100 GPU,不包括计量计算。 其迭代取样程序为处理大型无人驾驶航空器调查提出了额外的考虑,特别是在保留高分辨率获取的本地空间分辨率时。 在相应的计算预算下进行比较和在更大的图像分辨率下进行评价,将有助于在恢复质量和业务效率之间达成权衡。

blocks.en: Future research should prioritize spatially independent UAV surveys covering additional water types, depths, illumination conditions, and sensors, together with physically informed simulations incorporating measured water-column properties and seabed geometry. Limited real-data adaptation and uncertainty-aware restoration may further help address domain shifts and regions where seabed information is severely obscured [ 69 , 70 ] . Ultimately, independently validated downstream assessments are needed to establish whether the observed restoration improvements support more accurate coastal mapping and environmental monitoring.
blocks.zh: 未来的研究应优先考虑空间独立的无人驾驶航空器调查,包括额外的水型、深度、照明条件和传感器,以及包含测量水柱特性和海底几何特征的物理上知情的模拟。 对实际数据的调整和不确定性意识的恢复有限,可能进一步帮助处理海底信息严重模糊的领域变化和地区[69、70]。 归根结底,需要独立验证的下游评估,以确定所观察到的恢复改进是否有助于更准确的沿海测绘和环境监测。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This study introduced KAUSTics, a semi-synthetic dataset comprising 1,280 reference patches derived from 32 shallow-water UAV images and 12,800 paired degraded observations, together with KAUSTics-Net, a pixel-space conditional diffusion framework for through-water image restoration. The framework integrates multi-scale conditioning, FiLM-modulated residual blocks, cross-attention, and a composite training objective combining velocity prediction with structural and chromatic reconstruction losses.
blocks.zh: 这项研究介绍了KAUSTics,这是一个半合成数据集,由32个浅水无人驾驶飞行器图像产生的1,280个参考补丁和12,800个对齐的退化观测数据以及KAUSTics-Net,这是一个像素-空间条件传播框架,用于透水图像恢复。 框架整合了多尺度的调制,FiLM调制的残余块,交叉留心,以及结合速度预测与结构及色素重建损失的复合训练目标.

blocks.en: The revised evaluation used source-image-disjoint partitions, a common 256 × 256 256\times 256 image resolution, eight benchmark methods, and three independent training seeds. On KAUSTics, KAUSTics-Net achieved 31.715 ± 0.439 31.715\pm 0.439 dB PSNR, 0.849 ± 0.002 0.849\pm 0.002 SSIM, and 0.145 ± 0.007 0.145\pm 0.007 LPIPS. Following dataset-specific adaptation, it also achieved the highest PSNR and SSIM across the three evaluated Sea-Undistort configurations, although ResShift obtained better LPIPS and several no-reference metrics favored competing methods. Architectural ablations identified structural supervision as a particularly important component, while the real-UAV case study documented changes in feature detection and segmentation behavior.
blocks.zh: 修订后的评价采用源图像-离合分区,常见的256×256256\time256图像分辨率,8个基准方法,以及3个独立训练种子. 在KAUSTics上,KAUSTics-Net实现了31.715±0.439 31.715\pm 0.439 dB PSNR,0.849±0.002 0.849\pm 0.002 SSIM,以及0.145±0.007 0.145\pm 0.007 LPIPS. 在对数据集进行特定调整后,它也实现了三个经评价的Sea-Undistort配置中最高的PSNR和SSIM,尽管ResShift获得了更好的LPIPS和几个有利于竞争方法的无参考度量衡. 建筑浮雕将结构监督确定为特别重要的组成部分,而真实的UAV案例研究记录了特征检测和分区行为的变化.

blocks.en: The principal limitations concern the small number of independent source scenes, the synthetic-to-real domain gap, the absence of independently validated water-free references for KAUSTics, and the limited evidence of downstream mapping improvements. Further validation across geographically independent UAV surveys, measured water-column conditions, and quantitative remote-sensing tasks is required. Within these constraints, the study demonstrates the potential of semi-synthetic data and conditional diffusion for restoring shallow-water UAV imagery toward low-distortion reference appearances.
blocks.zh: 主要局限涉及:独立源场景数量少,合成到现实域间隙,KAUSTics缺乏独立验证的无水引用,下游测绘改进的证据有限. 需要在地理上独立的无人驾驶航空器调查、测量水柱条件和定量遥感任务中进一步验证。 在这些限制范围内,该研究表明半合成数据和有条件的传播对于将浅水无人驾驶飞行器图像恢复到低分解参考外观的潜力。

blocks.en: This supplement documents the sampler-aware adaptation procedure, provides full zero-shot Sea-Undistort comparisons, and illustrates the reference-patch inventory and appearance variation in KAUSTics. The zero-shot and fine-tuned evaluations are distinct. Sea-Undistort full-reference metrics are computed against the original synthetic water-free targets on the same 120 held-out scene identifiers per input configuration at 256 × 256 256\times 256 RGB resolution.
