blocks.en: Appendix SI Additional Adaptation Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录 SI 额外的适应实施细节

blocks.en:
Sampler-aware fine-tuning was performed in FP32 on one NVIDIA A100 GPU per seed, with gradient clipping at a global norm of 1. Each epoch consisted of 70 optimizer updates. The extra sampled-output objective was evaluated on updates 0, 4, … \ldots , 68 (18 of 70 updates), using microbatches of four to cover the effective batch of 12. The sampling procedure ran in evaluation mode. Gradients from the standard training objective and the sampler-aware objective were combined before each optimizer step. Sampled RGB mean squared error (MSE) used unclipped outputs, while the SSIM and blurred-CIELAB terms used the clipped RGB range. The first 21 DDIM sampling steps were detached, and differentiation was restricted to the last four steps.
Early stopping required at least 60 epochs and used a patience of five validation checks, with a minimum SSIM improvement of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . Each seed was initialized from its corresponding KAUSTics checkpoint, with a newly initialized AdamW optimizer. All three runs reached 100 epochs; validation-selected checkpoints were obtained at epochs 95, 100, and 100. Selection used the mean SSIM for all-effects validation scenes; the no-waves validation results were secondary. Test scene identifiers were excluded from optimization and checkpoint selection. However, preliminary Sea-Undistort test results had been inspected during the revision process, so the expanded adaptation experiment is exploratory and is not a newly blind external validation.
An initial LPIPS guard permitting an increase of at most 0.02 was not satisfied by any seed. This criterion was not retrospectively relaxed in the experimental record. Differences in model-specific schedules and the additional KAUSTics-Net adaptation experiments also mean that training and tuning effort were not matched across methods.
blocks.zh:
在FP32中,每个种子一个NVIDIA A100 GPU进行了标本-认识微调,梯度剪切为1。 每个时代包括70个优化器更新. 额外抽样产出目标在更新0,4,...\ldots,68(70个更新中的18个)上得到评价,使用4个的微管覆盖12个有效批次. 取样程序以评价方式进行。 从标准训练目标和采样器-意识目标中的梯度在每一个优化步骤之前合并. 抽样的RGB指平方误差(MSE)使用未剪切的输出,而SSIM和模糊的-CIELAB术语则使用剪切的RGB范围. 最初的21个DDIM取样步骤被剥离,区分仅限于最后四个步骤.
早期停机至少需要60个纪元,并使用了5次验证检查的耐心,最低SSIM改进为10−4 10^{-4}. 每个种子都从其对应的KAUSTics检查站初始化,并有一个新初始化的AdamW优化器. 所有三次运行都达到了100个纪元;95、100和100纪元时获得了若干验证检查站。 选用平均值SSIM进行全效验证场景;无波验证结果为二级. 测试场景识别器被排除在优化和检查站选择之外. 然而,在修订过程中已经检查了初步的Sea-Undistort测试结果,因此扩大的适应实验是探索性的,并不是新盲目的外部验证.
最初的LPIPS警卫允许最多增加0.02,但没有任何种子满足。 这一标准在实验记录中没有追溯性放松. 具体模式时间表和额外的KAUSTics-Net适应试验之间的差异也意味着培训和调试工作在方法上并不相称。

blocks.en: SI.A Sea-Undistort Fine-Tuning of the Benchmark Methods
blocks.zh: SI.A 基准方法的精细化

blocks.en: All eight baselines: CycleGAN, UGAN, FUnIE-GAN, DeWaterGAN, DiffWater, ResShift, SS-UIE, and U-Shape Transformer, were initialized from their corresponding seed-specific, validation-selected KAUSTics-trained restoration checkpoints. These were the same checkpoints used for the zero-shot Sea-Undistort evaluation. Restoration networks were therefore adapted from KAUSTics, rather than trained from scratch on Sea-Undistort. Optimizer states were reinitialized when adaptation began.
blocks.zh: 所有8个基线:CycleGAN、UGAN、FUNIE-GAN、DeWaterGAN、DiffWater、ResShift、SS-UIE和U-Shape变形器,均从其相应的种子专用、验证选定的KAUSTics训练修复检查站初始化。 这些检查站也是用于零弹射海-地下层评估的检查站。 因此,修复网络是从KAUSTics改编而成,而不是从零开始在海-Undistort上培训。 优化状态在适应开始后被重新初始化.

blocks.en: Every baseline used the same fixed partition of 840 training, 240 validation, and 120 test scene IDs, at RGB 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. Training used only the all-effects distorted inputs and the original water-free reference images from the 840 training scenes. No no-waves or no-sunglint configurations were added to the baseline training sets. CycleGAN and DeWaterGAN retained their unpaired training formulations: clean targets were sampled independently from the same 840-scene training pool. The other methods used the corresponding paired references.
blocks.zh: 每个基线使用相同的固定分区,即840次训练,240次验证,120次试验场ID,在RGB 256×256256\times 256分辨率. 训练只使用了扭曲的全效输入和840训练场景的原始无水参考图像. 基线培训组没有增加无波或无星林配置。 CycleGAN和DeWaterGAN保留了未经认证的训练配方:从同一个840场的训练池中独立抽取干净的目标. 其他方法使用相应的对称引用.

blocks.en: All baselines completed 100 fine-tuning epochs with a constant learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and no early stopping. Each epoch traversed all 840 distorted training inputs. Method-specific optimization objectives were retained; U-Shape Transformer continued its final L1-based training stage. Batch sizes were 8 for CycleGAN, DeWaterGAN, ResShift, and U-Shape Transformer; 128 for UGAN and FUnIE-GAN; 9 for SS-UIE; and 1 for DiffWater.
blocks.zh: 所有基线都完成了100个微调时段,持续学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5},没有提前停止。 每个时代都贯穿了所有840个扭曲的培训投入. 针对方法的优化目标得以保留;U-Shape Transformer继续其基于L1的最终培训阶段. 批量尺寸分别为CycleGAN,DeWaterGAN,ResShift和U-Shape变形器8个;UGAN和FUNIE-GAN128个;SS-UIE9个;DiffWater1个.

blocks.en: Checkpoint selection used the highest mean SSIM over all 240 all-effects validation scenes. The initial KAUSTics checkpoint, evaluated at epoch 0, remained eligible. For seven baselines, validation was performed at epochs 0, 1, 5, and every five epochs thereafter. For DiffWater, validation checks were performed every 20 epochs to reduce the cost of its native diffusion sampler. Consequently, validation frequency, and therefore checkpoint-selection opportunities, were not identical across methods.
blocks.zh: 检查点选择使用最高的平均值SSIM 在所有240全效验证场景中. 最初的KAUSTics检查站在0号纪元时评估,仍符合资格。 对于七个基线,在0、1、5以及其后每五个基准进行验证。 对DiffWater来说,每20个世纪就进行一次验证检查,以减少其本土传播取样器的成本。 因此,各种方法的验证频率以及因此的检查站选择机会并不相同。

blocks.en: Every baseline was fine-tuned using seeds 1, 2, and 3, starting from the matching KAUSTics training seed. The 120 test scene IDs were excluded from optimization and per-run checkpoint selection. Each selected checkpoint was evaluated on all three test-input variants, all-effects, no-waves, and no-sunglint, against the same original water-free reference.
blocks.zh: 每个基线都从匹配的KAUSTics训练种子开始使用种子1、2和3进行微调. 120个测试场景ID被排除在优化和每个运行的检查站选择之外. 每个选定的检查站都对照相同的原始无水参考,对所有三个测试输入变体、全效、无波和无成林进行了评估。

blocks.en: SII.A Protocol and Full-Reference Results
blocks.zh: SII.A 议定书和全面参考结果

blocks.en: Zero-shot transfer was evaluated using the KAUSTics-trained checkpoints without any Sea-Undistort optimization. This term refers to the source-trained experimental checkpoints, not externally released model weights. All eight benchmark methods used their completed KAUSTics training runs under the 100-epoch warm-up and patience-10 rule, with validation-selected checkpoints. KAUSTics-Net used its longer-trained, validation-selected checkpoint. These training schedules were not matched for total computation. The comparison uses identical held-out scenes under all-effects, no-waves, and no-sunglint inputs, each evaluated against the original water-free reference image.
blocks.zh: 通过KAUSTics训练的检查站评估了零射线转移,没有优化海-地下结构。 这个术语是指源头训练的实验检查站,而不是外部释放的模型重量. 所有八种基准方法都采用了他们完成的KAUSTics训练,按照100世纪的热身和耐心-10规则进行,并设有若干验证检查站。 KAUSTics-Net使用了其经过长期训练的、经过验证的检查站。 这些培训时间表与计算总数不符。 比较在全效下使用相同的被搁置场景,无波和无星林输入,每个场景都根据原始无水参考图像进行评估.

blocks.en: On all-effects observations, KAUSTics-Net achieved 9.418 ± 0.094 9.418\pm 0.094 dB PSNR and 0.233 ± 0.012 0.233\pm 0.012 SSIM, below the unprocessed input ( 10.257 10.257 dB and 0.311 0.311 , respectively). These results document a substantial synthetic-domain shift and should not be conflated with the gains achieved after Sea-Undistort fine-tuning in the main manuscript. Table S1 presents the complete full-reference comparison.

blocks.en: Appendix SIII KAUSTics Dataset Inventory and Appearance Examples
blocks.zh: 附录SIII KAUSTics 数据集目录和外观实例

blocks.en: The dataset inventory contains 32 original UAV-image identifiers and 1,280 reference patches, with 40 patches per source image. Ten distorted variants per reference yield 12,800 input–reference pairs. Each reference is counted once in the spatial-pixel inventory. The original reference patches are 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixels, and the experiments resize both references and distorted observations to 256 × 256 256\times 256 pixels. The original-file audit identified one degraded training image stored at 1344 × 1344 1344\times 1344 pixels; the other 12,799 degraded images are 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 pixels. The source audit inspected 28,160 original and resized image-file headers without modifying the original files.
blocks.zh: 数据集目录包含32个原始无人机图像识别符和1,280个参考补丁,每个源图像有40个补丁. 每个参考文献的10个扭曲变体产量为12,800个输入-参考对。 每个引用在空间像素目录中计算一次. 原始的参考补丁为1000×1000×1000×1000×1000×1000像素,实验将参考和扭曲的观测都调整为256×256×256××256像素. 原始文件审核发现一个已退化的训练图像存储在1344×1344\times 1344像素;其他12,799个已退化图像为1000×1000\times 1000像素. 来源审计检查了28,160个原始和重新大小的图像文件头,但没有修改原始文件。

blocks.en: The 1,280 original reference patches contain 1,280,000,000 spatial pixels. After resizing, the references contain 83,886,080 spatial pixels. The training, validation, and test groups account for 1,040, 120, and 120 reference patches, respectively, corresponding to 1,040,000,000, 120,000,000, and 120,000,000 original spatial pixels. The resized totals are 68,157,440, 7,864,320, and 7,864,320 spatial pixels. These figures represent image sampling volume, not unique geographic coverage, habitat area, or independent scene diversity.

blocks.en: The following image groups describe representative patch appearances from a single shallow-water lagoon: hard-bottom or rock-like texture, sand-dominated appearance, vegetation-like or mixed benthic texture, and dark or low-visibility appearance. These descriptions are visual categories and were not field-validated as substrate classes or species identities. In particular, image darkness and blue tint do not independently establish water depth. Habitat-classification frameworks such as Reef Cover can inform descriptive terminology, but the KAUSTics patches do not include a verified patch-level habitat label manifest. Consequently, category proportions and class-specific pixel counts are not reported.
blocks.zh: 以下图像组描述单个浅水泻湖中具有代表性的补丁外观:硬底或岩状纹理,以沙质为主的外观,植被状或混合底质,以及暗或低可见的外观. 这些描述是视觉类,没有作为底物类或物种特征进行实地验证. 特别是,图像黑暗和蓝锡不能独立确定水深. 诸如Reef Cover等生境分类框架可以为描述性术语提供信息,但KAUSTics的补丁不包括经过核实的补丁级生境标签。 因此,没有报告类别比例和特定类像素计数。

blocks.en: The corresponding augmented observations illustrate how the same base textures appear under two rendered caustic patterns, two Gaussian-blurred variants, and three empirical color-transfer presets. These transformations introduce different local illumination and radiometric appearances but do not expand the number of independent source scenes. Color presets represent neither measured depth levels nor calibrated light-attenuation coefficients. Visual variation within this survey is not evidence of generalization across independent coastal environments.
blocks.zh: 相应的增量观测显示,同样的基质纹理是如何在两种变异的致癌图案、两种高斯蓝色变异和三种经验性色转移预设下出现的。 这些转变引入了不同的局部照明和辐射外观,但并不扩大独立源场景的数量. 彩色预设既不代表测量的深度水平,也不代表校准的光加速系数. 本次调查的视觉差异并不能证明在独立的沿海环境中的概况。
